eligibility_notes: Provisional: program page requires a four-year degree in 'computer science, computer engineering or a cognate area'; no stated non-CS or experience pathway, so a Geography BSc is a real risk (borderline, not rejected because 'cognate' is open to judgement and a relevant-experience case could be asked). English waived via MOI letter. Cheap (about 9.7k CAD plus fees), 16 months, course-based, no co-op found. Curriculum is software-engineering oriented (design, V&V, algorithms) with some architecture/security electives; limited cloud/IT management content. Ask program about non-CS and professional experience.
